title: Autocrafting Table by Sephamm
description: Autocrafting Table brings simple and powerful automation to Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. Define a recipe with a pattern, supply items in the buffer, and let the table craft automatically and output items to connected inventories.
body:
Autocrafting Table by Sephamm

Autocrafting Table by Sephamm adds a powerful and intuitive automatic crafting solution to Minecraft, designed to simplify automation while staying close to the vanilla experience.

The Autocrafting Table uses a 3×3 pattern system to define recipes and a separate internal buffer to store and consume crafting materials. Once configured, the table crafts items automatically at a configurable interval, without requiring redstone or player interaction.

Crafted items can be exported directly into connected inventories such as chests, allowing seamless integration into automated setups and farms.

✨ Features

Automatic crafting without redstone

3×3 pattern grid to define recipes

Separate internal buffer for consumed items

Automatic output to connected inventories

Configurable crafting speed via commands

Clean, vanilla-inspired GUI

Fully compatible with Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

🕹️ Commands

/sephamm autocraft interval – shows the current crafting interval

/sephamm autocraft interval <ticks> – changes the crafting speed

/sephamm autocraft interval reset – resets to default values

🔨 Crafting

The Autocrafting Table can be crafted using a balanced recipe that fits naturally into the game’s progression.

📌 Notes

The pattern is never consumed

Only valid recipes are processed

Crafting stops automatically when resources run out

No item duplication

Works with all standard vanilla crafting recipes
